configuration_profile: direct incremental ngx_http_v2_state_head with build-only side-effect-free body-handler substitution
justification: The existing HTTP/1 adapter builds the HTTP/2 module but never supplies HTTP/2 wire framing.
state: Every prefix from zero through the complete nine-byte header is passed to a fresh nginx HTTP/2 parser state; complete headers retain nginx's real known/unknown type dispatch.
known_limitations: Frame body handlers are replaced during the hook, so DATA flow control, stream lifecycle, SETTINGS effects and response frames are not covered.
HPACK primitives are covered separately by NGX-IF10; full HEADERS/CONTINUATION request construction remains out of scope.
The frame hook is applied only to the isolated instrumented build copy and assumes single-threaded libFuzzer execution.

scopes.contract: Incrementally collect a nine-byte HTTP/2 frame header, decode length/type/flags/stream ID and dispatch known types or skip unknown ones.
scopes.preconditions: A fresh HTTP/2 connection state and at most nine visible input bytes.
